name: CS
desc: Tactical 5v5 bot matches: Snow Arena, Dust II, and authored Inferno / Mirage recreations with photographic map materials.
descZh: 浏览器 5v5 战术人机对战：雪地、沙城Ⅱ，以及自建复刻的炼狱小镇与荒漠迷城，搭配实拍地图材质。

keyboard.actionZh: 瞄准 / 射击（点击锁定指针）

touch.actionZh: 左侧移动摇杆，右侧转视角
开火 / 换弹 / 跳跃 / 使用按钮

keyboard.actionZh: 主武器 / 手枪 / 刀 / 手雷 / C4
丢枪 / 上一武器 / 检视
静步 / 蹲下 / 跳跃

notes.text: Choose classic, karambit or butterfly in the game's Settings. Butterfly uses two draw sequences and one reference-led inspect sequence.
notes.textZh: 在游戏设置中选择经典刀、爪刀或蝴蝶刀；蝴蝶刀有两种拔刀动作和一种参考原作重建的检视动作。

notes.text: Empty magazines reload automatically when reserve ammunition remains. Press R to reload early.
notes.textZh: 有备弹时，弹匣打空会自动换弹；按 R 可提前换弹。

keyboard.action: Pick up / hold to plant or defuse
keyboard.actionZh: 拾取 / 按住安放或拆除

keyboard.action: Settings / return to play / close panel
keyboard.actionZh: 设置 / 继续游戏 / 关闭面板

notes.text: Elimination, bomb defusal and team deathmatch are local matches against bots, not online multiplayer.
notes.textZh: 回合歼灭、经典爆破与团队竞技均为本地人机对战，不含在线多人服务。

notes.text: Settings → More settings also opens the scoreboard and radio. Choose radio messages by tapping or keys 1–8; 0 or Escape closes. Opening radio during play does not pause the round.
notes.textZh: 设置 → 更多设置也可打开记分板和无线电。无线电可点选或按数字键 1–8，0 / Esc 关闭；对局中打开无线电不会暂停回合。
